lines.en: I go to knock on Miku’s door and-
lines.zh: 我走过去敲 Miku 的门，然后——

lines.en: : Miku! Are you really planning on going out tonight?
: The weather forecast says it’s supposed to rain. You don’t even have an umbrella.
lines.zh: : 天气预报说会下雨。你连伞都没带。

lines.en: And I suddenly hear Makoto lecturing the girl I am here to see.
lines.zh: 接着，我忽然听见 Makoto 正在训斥我来要找的那个女孩。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine! It never rains around here. And those weather thingies are always wrong anyway.
lines.zh: : 没事的啦！这一带从来不下雨。而且那些天气预报本来就从来没准过。

lines.en: : Well, that may be true, but-
: I said I’ll be fine! Just go back to yer borin’ ole’ books and let me get my night run in.
lines.zh: : 我都说了我没事！你回去看你的破书吧，让我把今晚的夜跑跑完。

lines.en: : Just call me if you need anything and I can have my mom go pick you up.
lines.zh: : 有什么事就给我打电话，我让我妈去接你。

lines.en: : Roger that! See ya in a few hours!
The conversation comes to a stop and, before I know it-
lines.zh: 对话戛然而止，而我还没反应过来——

lines.en: : Sensei? What are you doin' over here?
: Same thing I’m always doing over here. Trying to kill time.
lines.zh: : 跟我平时在这儿干的一样。消磨时间罢了。

lines.en: : Wherever. Was in the mood to get my body movin’ so I was thinkin’ about hittin' up my normal route.
lines.zh: : 随便哪儿。就是想活动活动身子，所以打算跑一趟平时的路线。

lines.en: : Wanna come with me? It’s the same one I took you to last time that you totally hated.
lines.zh: : 要一起来吗？就是上次带你走的那条，你讨厌得要死的那条。

lines.en: : So...you’re inviting me again despite knowing I hated it?
lines.zh: : 所以……明知道我讨厌，你还要再邀请我一次？

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess so. Not like I had anything better to do.
lines.zh: : 行吧，我去。反正也没有什么更好的事可做。

lines.en: : Sure you don’t wanna go talk to Makoto instead? She could probably use the company.
lines.zh: : 你真不想去跟 Makoto 说说话吗？她大概需要人陪陪。

lines.en: : Who the heck studies this late anyway? This is prime time for doin’ fun stuff!
lines.zh: : 谁这么晚了还学习啊？这可是干点好玩的事的黄金时间！

lines.en: : You might be underestimating just how much fun Makoto has while studying.
lines.zh: : 你可能低估了 Makoto 学习时能有多开心。

lines.en: To be fair, though, it’s highly plausible that she’ll use her time to do other...Makoto things instead.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，她很可能把时间花在别的……Makoto 式的事情上。

lines.en: I’ll leave her be for now and catch up with her some other time.
lines.zh: 我今天先不打扰她，改天再去找她。

lines.en: : You sure it’s going to be fine with the rain, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，下雨真的没问题吗？

lines.en: : Course I am. When was the last time you saw it rain here? Just doesn’t happen.
lines.zh: : 当然没问题。你上次在这儿看见下雨是什么时候？根本就不会下。

lines.en: : Startin’ to think there might be some kinda top secret barrier hoverin’ over the city preventin’ us from gettin' stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 我都开始觉得，城市上空是不是罩着什么绝密屏障，把这种东西全挡在外面了。

lines.en: : Already got one surrounding us. Another on top wouldn't hurt.
lines.zh: : 我们周围已经有一层了。顶上再罩一层也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : Interesting theory. A dome would definitely explain the extremely predictable weather pattern.
lines.zh: : 有意思的理论。穹顶确实能解释这过于规律的天气。

lines.en: : You know it! Now get yer friggin' butt into gear and let’s get a move on, Sensei! The night waits for no one!
lines.zh: : 说得好！现在把你那该死的屁股给我动起来，出发了，Sensei！夜晚可不等人！

lines.en: : Last one to the street has to buy the other a condo!
lines.zh: : 最后一个跑到街上的，得给对方买一套公寓！

lines.en: Miku bolts past me and like always, jumps down an entire flight of stairs on the way outside- leaving me all alone with an unanswered question.
lines.zh: Miku 从我身边一冲而过，一如既往地在出门的路上直接跳下整整一段楼梯——把我一个人丢在原地，带着一个没人回答的问题。

lines.en: Miku and I spend the next thirty-minutes or so jogging to the same area she took me to the last time we went out at night.
lines.zh: 接下来的三十分钟左右，我和 Miku 一路慢跑，前往上次夜里出门时她带我去的那个地方。

lines.en: Surprisingly enough, I didn’t completely hate myself the entire way here this time around.
lines.zh: 出乎意料的是，这一路上我并没有像上次那样从头到尾痛恨自己。

lines.en: Could it be that just being around Miku is enough to train my stamina without actually having to do anything?
lines.zh: 难道说，只要待在 Miku 身边，什么都不用做就能把耐力练出来？

lines.en: If so, I should probably hang around her a little more often.
lines.zh: 如果是这样，我大概该多跟她待在一起。

lines.en: It might add a few more years to my life.
: Hey. Mind explaining why we’re stopping in the middle of the road instead of some storefront porch or something?
lines.zh: : 喂。能解释一下我们为什么停在马路正中间，而不是哪家店的屋檐底下吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Don’t see why it matters. Not like any cars are gonna come around here this time of night.
lines.zh: : 嗯？有什么关系嘛。这么晚了，这一带不会有车过来的。

lines.en: : No one really drives over here anyway since a lot of these places are out of business.
lines.zh: : 反正也没人往这边开车，这些店大多都倒闭了。

lines.en: : Is that why you normally come here to run instead of like, the park or something?
lines.zh: : 所以你平时才来这儿跑步，而不是去公园什么的？

lines.en: : There are a bunch of reasons I come here, but I guess that would be one of ‘em, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿的理由有一堆，不过这也算其中一个吧，嗯。

lines.en: : It’s also nice that the streetlights work. For some reason, the ones in the park get all...flickery sometimes and it gives me the friggin’ creeps.
lines.zh: : 而且这儿的路灯还亮着，挺好的。不知怎么的，公园里那些灯有时会一闪一闪的，看得我他妈发毛。

lines.en: : Do you get scared easily, Miku?
: The heck do you think? Was one panic attack not enough for ya? Want me to flip out again?
lines.zh: : 你说呢？一次恐慌发作还不够你受的？还想看我再崩溃一次？

lines.en: : I meant in general. From things that don’t involve loud noises.
lines.zh: : 我是说一般情况下。那些跟巨响无关的东西。

lines.en: : Haven’t ever really thought about it before.
: I just try to take things as they come. If ya spend yer entire life livin’ in fear, yer gonna wind up missin’ out on some pretty great things.
lines.zh: : 我只是尽量兵来将挡。要是一辈子都活在恐惧里，最后肯定会错过很多很棒的东西。

lines.en: : Like, for example, if I was scared of the dark, we wouldn’t have been able to come out here tonight.
lines.zh: : 比如说，要是我怕黑，我们今晚就出不来了。

lines.en: : Which means ya’d probably be back in the dorm room playin’ tonsil-hockey with Makoto while she tries to study or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 那就是说，你大概会待在宿舍里，趁 Makoto 学习的时候跟她玩“扁桃体曲棍球”什么的。

lines.en: : And I’d probably be at Karin’s house doin’ sit-ups and watchin’ shark documentaries on her fancy TV.
lines.zh: : 而我大概会在 Karin 家里做仰卧起坐，用她那台高级电视看鲨鱼纪录片。

lines.en: : That’s an interesting set of hypotheticals you swapped this out for. I’m not so sure about the tonsil-hockey part, though.
lines.zh: : 你换上来的这堆假设倒是挺有意思。不过“扁桃体曲棍球”那部分我可不敢苟同。

lines.en: As a matter of fact...have I ever even kissed Makoto?
lines.zh: 话说回来……我到底有没有吻过 Makoto？

lines.en: How the hell did we skip kissing on the way to sex?
lines.zh: 我们到底是怎么跳过接吻，直接走到上床那一步的？

lines.en: I suddenly feel even worse about taking her virginity than I did before. Which was still kind of bad.
lines.zh: 我忽然觉得，夺走她第一次这件事比之前更让我过意不去了。虽然之前也够糟的。

lines.en: She asked probably a thousand times.
: It’s gonna be a real buzzkill havin’ to change up my route soon, ya know?
lines.zh: : 马上就得换路线了，真够扫兴的，你知道吧？

lines.en: : What? Why would you have to change your route?
lines.zh: : 什么？你为什么要换路线？

lines.en: : This place normally fills up with snow pretty quick in the winter.
lines.zh: : 这地方一到冬天很快就积满雪。

lines.en: : Falls right through the cracks in the overhangs and sticks to the cement so hard that ya can’t even {i}think{/i} about runnin’ on it without fallin’ over and crackin’ yer skull.
lines.zh: : 雪顺着雨棚的缝漏下来，牢牢粘在水泥地上，{i}想{/i}在上头跑简直是找摔，非把脑袋磕碎不可。

lines.en: : What are you going to do instead, then?
: As if you don’t already spend enough time there.
lines.zh: : 好像你在那儿待的时间还不够长似的。

lines.en: : Well, it’s that or a treadmill at one of the other girls’ houses and I’m not a big fan of indoor exercise. Just doesn’t feel the same, ya know?
lines.zh: : 嗯，要么就是去别的女生家里跑跑步机，可我不太喜欢室内运动。感觉就是不一样，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Not really. Exercise is exercise. I don’t think it matters whether you’re indoors or outdoors.
lines.zh: : 不太懂。运动就是运动，我觉得在室内还是室外无所谓。

lines.en: : Take a look up and try sayin’ that again, why don’t ya?
lines.zh: : 那你抬头看看，再把刚才那句话重说一遍试试？

lines.en: I take a look up and find exactly what I expect to find.
lines.zh: 我抬起头，看到的正是我所预料的。

lines.en: Why does everyone always expect me to think there’s something beautiful about it when it’s just a dark, expansive blanket of dead stars?
lines.zh: 明明只是一大片黑暗、铺展开来的死星之毯，为什么每个人都指望我觉得它美？

lines.en: First it was Maya...now it’s Miku.
These girls would be better off looking for beauty in things that are still living rather than things that died a long, long time ago.
lines.zh: 这些女孩与其在很久很久以前就死掉的东西里寻找美，不如去还活着的东西里找。

lines.en: : Pretty cool, right? Can’t see that indoors, now can ya?
lines.zh: : 挺酷的吧？在室内可看不到这个，对吧？

lines.en: : I mean, you could buy those stick-on stars that young girls normally attach to their ceilings and get something...kind of similar.
lines.zh: : 我是说，你也可以买那种小女生贴在天花板上的夜光星星，效果大概差不多。

lines.en: : Oh! I always wanted those when I was little!
lines.zh: : 哦！我小时候一直想要那个！

lines.en: : Think Makoto would let me stick 'em to the ceiling of the dorm room?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Makoto 会让我把它们贴到宿舍天花板上吗？

lines.en: : Makoto? Absolutely not. There’s probably some sort of rule against it.
lines.zh: : Makoto？绝对不行。大概有条什么规矩禁止这么做。

lines.en: : Ugh...really? But we're allowed to hang up posters.
lines.zh: : 呃……真的吗？可海报不是让挂嘛。

lines.en: : Hey, don't ask me. Ask your walking rulebook of a roommate.
lines.zh: : 哎，别问我。去问你那位活体校规室友。

lines.en: : How'd a free spirited tomboy like me end up with such a strict best friend anyway? What kinda nonsense is that?
lines.zh: : 我这么一个自由奔放的假小子，怎么就摊上这么个严格的闺蜜了？什么破事啊？

lines.en: : Chances are you just gravitated toward someone to keep you in check.
lines.zh: : 大概你是本能地靠近了一个能管住你的人。

lines.en: : That whole thing about opposites attracting isn’t as untrue as-
lines.zh: : 所谓“相异相吸”那套说法，也不算全是假的——

lines.en: : Oh, would ya look at the time? Break’s over, Sensei! Time to start runnin’ again!
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧瞧都几点了？休息结束啦，Sensei！该继续跑了！

lines.en: : Come on, that tangent wasn’t going to be nearly as boring as you expected it to be...
lines.zh: : 拜托，那段跑题才没有你想的那么无聊呢……

lines.en: : Get up! We’re not even halfway done yet!
lines.zh: : 起来！我们连一半都还没跑完呢！

lines.en: : Ya can talk about yer borin’ life lessons while we do another lap!
lines.zh: : 你可以边跑下一圈边讲你那套无聊的人生道理！

lines.en: : Wait, we're not even halfway done? Just how long are you planning on going tonight?
lines.zh: : 等等，连一半都还没跑完？你今晚到底打算跑多久？

lines.en: : At least another hour! Now get a move on before I leave ya in the dust!
lines.zh: : 至少一个小时！赶紧动起来，不然我就把你甩在后面吃灰了！

lines.en: Miku and I start jogging once again, back down the same streets we took on our first lap.
lines.zh: 我和 Miku 再次开始慢跑，沿着第一圈跑过的同一条街往回走。

lines.en: It’s clear that she has a defined route she likes to stick to, so I remain at her side just trying to keep up.
lines.zh: 很明显她有自己固定的路线，所以我只是跟在她旁边，努力不掉队。

lines.en: When we first did this, she had no problem lowering her pace to make sure I didn’t give up. But now it’s like she’s intentionally speeding up to try and...make me {i}improve{/i} or something.
lines.zh: 第一次跑的时候，她会毫不在意地放慢速度，确保我不至于放弃。可现在她像是在故意加速，想让我{i}有所长进{/i}什么的。

lines.en: I don’t want to improve, though.
Improving means that I’d need to run even more to ensure I don’t slip into bad shape again.
lines.zh: 长进就意味着我得跑得更多，才能保证自己不再退化回那副糟糕的身板。

lines.en: And, I know this might sound shocking, but I {i}hate{/i} running.
lines.zh: 而且——我知道这话听起来可能有点吓人——但我{i}讨厌{/i}跑步。

lines.en: Another fifteen minutes pass by and I can no longer keep up with Miku.
lines.zh: 又过了十五分钟，我再也跟不上 Miku 了。

lines.en: She makes it to the end of each street long before I do and simply jogs in place, waiting for me to catch up.
lines.zh: 她总是远远先我一步跑到每条街的尽头，然后原地小跑，等我追上去。

lines.en: Eventually, I go from feeling pretty good to feeling like I’m going to pass out if I take another step...
lines.zh: 终于，我从“感觉还不错”变成了“再多走一步就要昏过去”……

lines.en: : Come on, Sensei! Yer doin’ great!
: Just one more lap and we can head on home!
lines.zh: : 再跑一圈我们就可以回家了！
: 跑……不动……了……一……圈……也……跑不了……

lines.en: : Sure ya can! I believe in you!
My instincts tell me to pull this girl to safety and hide her away from two different storms.
lines.zh: 我的本能告诉我，要把这个女孩拉到安全的地方，把她从两场不同的风暴里藏起来。

lines.en: The first of the two batters us with heavy raindrops and soaks us to the core.
lines.zh: 第一场用沉甸甸的雨点砸向我们，把我们淋得透湿。

lines.en: I’m colder now than I’ve ever felt before.
lines.zh: 我现在比以往任何时候都冷。

lines.en: The second storm is the one you probably assumed I was alluding to.
lines.zh: 第二场风暴，大概就是你们以为我在暗指的那一场。

lines.en: The one inside of her head, causing her legs to shake and her eyes to grow wide and fill with tears.
lines.zh: 在她脑子里的那一场，让她的双腿发抖，让她的双眼越睁越大、蓄满泪水。

lines.en: I grab Miku’s hand and pull her under the first archway I can find to shelter her from the rain.
lines.zh: 我抓住 Miku 的手，把她拉进我能找到的第一个拱门底下，替她挡雨。

lines.en: I’m not sure what is going on, but letting her just stand here in the middle of a downpour isn’t going to help in any way.
lines.zh: 我不清楚到底发生了什么，但就这么让她站在暴雨里，怎么都不会有任何帮助。

lines.en: I ignore Miku’s resistance and pull her with all of my strength.
lines.zh: 我无视 Miku 的反抗，用尽全身力气把她拉过来。

lines.en: She struggles for a minute or two, almost falling to the ground time and time again.
lines.zh: 她挣扎了一两分钟，一次又一次差点摔倒在地。

lines.en: Because she is so much weaker than me.
The resistance finally ends and she locks herself around my arm.
lines.zh: 反抗终于结束，她死死地缠住我的手臂。

lines.en: My body converts from a living, sentient organism to an inanimate object meant to provide solace to a girl who has slipped her tongue into the mouth of Hell.
lines.zh: 我的身体从一个活生生的、有知觉的生命，变成了一件没有生命的物件，只为了给一个已经把舌头探进地狱之口的女孩提供慰藉。

lines.en: I want to comfort her, but I cannot.

lines.zh: 它就这样没完没了地持续着。

lines.en: : The thunder only struck twice and the rain’s already started to slow down.
lines.zh: : 雷只打了两下，雨也已经开始小了。
: 等雨停了……我们就回去吧。

lines.en: : Makoto’s not gonna be happy when I walk into the room soakin’ wet.
lines.zh: : 我要是浑身湿透地走进房间，Makoto 肯定不会高兴。

lines.en: : Wanna stay at my place instead?
: No thanks. I don't wanna have to explain things to Ami and...I kinda need my body pillow to fall asleep.
lines.zh: : 不了，谢谢。我不想跟 Ami 解释这些，而且……我有点离不开我的抱枕才睡得着。

lines.en: : Is it okay if...I hang on to you for now, though? I don’t think I can hold myself up on my own just yet.
lines.zh: : 不过……我能先这么靠着你吗？我觉得自己现在还站不太稳。

lines.en: The rain stops within the next fifteen minutes.
lines.zh: 接下来的十五分钟里，雨停了。

lines.en: The two of us remain under the archway of an unfamiliar store for five extra minutes just to make sure the storm doesn’t start up again.
lines.zh: 我们俩又在那家陌生店铺的拱门底下多待了五分钟，只为确认暴雨不会再来。

lines.en: When it doesn’t, we quietly and awkwardly make our way back to the dorm.
lines.zh: 确认它没再下之后，我们安静而尴尬地往宿舍走。

lines.en: Before making the walk of shame back upstairs in her still-damp hoodie, Miku wraps her arms around me and gives me the single coldest hug I’ve ever had in my life.
lines.zh: 在穿着那件仍湿漉漉的连帽衫、带着一身狼狈上楼之前，Miku 张开双臂抱住我，给了我这辈子最冷的一个拥抱。

lines.en: It starts raining again halfway through my walk home.
lines.zh: 我走回家走到一半，天又开始下雨了。
